text: Security is a crucial part of web development. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server. This protects sensitive information like passwords. Second, implement strong authentication so only the right people can access accounts. Third, validate all user input to prevent attacks such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting. Developers must also be aware of common vulnerabilities, including broken access control and insecure cookies. By following these practices, you can build safer websites that protect both users and data from online threats.
